AIConfig.description: AIConfig configures the off-gate LLM provider (`ai:`).

enabled.description: Enable state: true | false | "auto" (on/off are not accepted)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

Analyzer.description: Analyzer is the common enable/gate shape for analyzers with no extra knobs (`analyzers.syntax`, `analyzers.cargo_modules`).

AnalyzersConfig.description: AnalyzersConfig groups the opt-in analyzer settings (`analyzers:`).

min_severity.description:
MinSeverity is the minimum severity for a coupling advisory to appear:
low | medium | high | critical (default medium). low is noisy on
well-designed codebases; high/critical surface only intrusive/functional
coupling across large boundaries.

duplicated_knowledge.description:
DuplicatedKnowledge controls clone-only duplicated knowledge (cross-module
clone pairs with no import edge). "score" (default) includes those pairs in
coupling_balance; "advisory" preserves the v4 report-only behavior.

volatility_cascade.description:
VolatilityCascade enables the book Ch9 propagation pass: a module strongly
coupled to a high-effective-volatility module inherits raised effective
volatility. The pass runs to a deterministic fixpoint and never lowers values.

gate.description:
Gate configures the coupling verdict gate (`coupling.gate:`). An absent
block is not an absent policy: the distributed-monolith rule always runs
and defaults to mode warn with max_new_seams 0.

CouplingConfig.description: CouplingConfig tunes the Balanced-Coupling advisory pass (`coupling:`).

distributed_monolith.description:
DistributedMonolith is the v2 coupling gate: it counts logical seams, not
import edges, and blocks only on newly introduced qualifying seams
against a comparable reference.

CouplingGateDef.description: CouplingGateDef configures the coupling verdict gate (`coupling.gate:`).

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

CoverageConfig.description: CoverageConfig configures opt-in ingestion of coverage artifacts produced by the caller's CI.

CoverageSource.description: CoverageSource is one supplied coverage artifact.

mode.description:
Mode is warn (diagnostic, the default) or fail (blocking). Fail is opt-in
and is never inferred automatically: it stays an owner decision taken after
a report-only run against a comparable reference.

max_new_seams.description:
MaxNewSeams is the tolerated number of newly introduced qualifying seams.
Unset means 0. It applies only in fail mode and only when the comparison
reference is comparable.

DistributedMonolithDef.description: DistributedMonolithDef configures the distributed-monolith seam rule (`coupling.gate.distributed_monolith:`).

targets.description:
Targets are glob patterns matched against the classified edge target —
the same node identity the language extractor emits: a Go import path
("github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/**"), a TS resolved package path
("node_modules/@aws-sdk/**") or bare specifier, a Python dotted module
("boto3.**"), or a Rust crate name ("aws_sdk_s3").

volatility.description:
Volatility of the external system: high | medium | low | frozen.
Default low — the book's generic-subdomain guidance (an external vendor
system is a generic capability, presumed stable unless declared otherwise).

ExternalSystemDef.description: ExternalSystemDef declares one external integration seam (`external_systems:`), per book Ch10 Example 1 (cross-vendor integration).

generated_globs.description:
GeneratedGlobs are glob patterns (matched against the repo-relative
slash path) that classify a file as Generated. Supports doublestar (`**`)
semantics (github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar); `**` matches across path
separators. Example: ["**/generated/**", "*.pb.go"]

test_globs.description:
TestGlobs are glob patterns that classify a file as Test.
Example: ["*_helpers_test.go", "testutil/**"]

mock_frameworks.description:
MockFrameworks contains filename prefix/suffix patterns (matched against
the base filename only) that identify mock files as Generated. Used for
custom mock code-generators not covered by built-in naming conventions.
Example: ["fake_", "_double"]

FileClassDef.description: FileClassDef holds optional user-supplied patterns for source-file classification.

enabled.description: Enable state: true | false | "auto" (on/off are not accepted)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

include.description: keep only members matching these globs; empty = all

exclude.description: drop members matching these globs; applied after include

GoModuleFilter.description: GoModuleFilter restricts Go workspace analysis to a subset of go.work members (`languages.go.modules`).

LanguagesConfig.description: LanguagesConfig groups the per-language extractor settings (`languages:`).

enabled.description:
Metrics run by default: a knob-only entry (e.g. only `gate: warn`)
stays enabled, and only an explicit `enabled: false` disables the
metric. (Pointer so absent and false decode differently.)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

MetricEntry.description: MetricEntry holds the settings for a single metric inside the metrics map.

MetricsConfig.description: MetricsConfig holds gate settings for computed metrics plus diagnostic-only complexity settings.

depends_on.description:
DependsOn is the outbound allowlist: the only declared modules this
module may import. Each entry is a module name or a module selector
("layer:<name>", "role:<role>", or a glob over module names). An absent
key leaves the module unconstrained; an empty list allows no first-party
module. The module_dependencies rule enforces it; external targets are
out of its scope.

visible_to.description:
VisibleTo is the inbound allowlist: the only declared modules that may
import this module, with the same entry forms as depends_on. An absent
key leaves the module visible to every module; an importer that no
module owns is always denied.

ModuleDef.description: ModuleDef defines a module's path ownership and metadata.

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

ModuleReviewConfig.description: ModuleReviewConfig configures staleness gating of the module declarations: archfit warns (or fails) when a module's `reviewed_at` is older than stale_after, nudging a periodic re-check of the architecture map.

OutputsConfig.description: OutputsConfig controls which output formats are produced.

PatternDef.description: Def declares a single structural pattern rule for the pattern-search port.

enabled.description: Enable state: true | false | "auto" (on/off are not accepted)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

package.description:
Package is the top-level importable package name passed to grimp
(e.g. "myapp"). Empty = auto-detect from the project layout.

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

guard.description:
Guard marks an intentional guard rule whose from:/to: selector is expected
to match nothing, such as a ban on re-introducing a deleted package. A
guard counts as evaluated while its selector matches nothing; any other
rule with a selector that matches nothing is reported as not evaluated.

from_module.description:
FromModule selects the importing modules of a forbidden_dependency rule
instead of from: "layer:<name>" selects every module with that layer,
"role:<role>" every module with that role, and any other text is a glob
over declared module names. A module selector matches only edges between
two different modules.

to_module.description:
ToModule selects the imported modules of a forbidden_dependency rule
instead of to:, with the same selector forms as from_module.

rationale.description:
Rationale says why the rule exists. It is appended to every finding's
why as " — <rationale>" and repeated in the repair task's constraints.

alternatives.description:
Alternatives name what to do instead. They become the finding's
allowed_alternatives and repair-task constraints.

docs.description:
Docs points at the document that explains the rule, such as an ADR. It
is appended to every finding's constraint as " (see <docs>)".

RuleDef.description: RuleDef declares a single architecture rule.

enabled.description: Enable state: true | false | "auto" (on/off are not accepted)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

manifest.description: Manifest is the path to Cargo.toml. Empty = auto (the root manifest).

features.description: Features are the cargo features to activate for `cargo metadata`.

include_dev_deps.description: IncludeDevDeps adds dev-dependencies as crate edges.

enabled.description: Enable state: true | false | "auto" (on/off are not accepted)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

TimedAnalyzer.description: TimedAnalyzer adds a per-run subprocess timeout (`analyzers.scip`, `analyzers.clones`).

enabled.description: Enable state: true | false | "auto" (on/off are not accepted)

gate.description: Gate posture: off (skip the check) | warn (advisory) | fail (blocking); defaults depend on the configured rule or metric

WaiverDef.description: WaiverDef grants an approved, time-boxed deviation from a rule (`waivers:`).

external_systems.description:
ExternalSystems declares external integration seams (book Ch10 Example 1)
whose edges enter coupling_balance scoring at declared_external (D=10).
